🚨 *new alert — needs human*
Channel: alert-frontend-errors  •  confidence: 0.55  •  bug-type guess: env (client-side network)  •  alerts in group: 4

Symptoms:
  - Monitor `77419271` ("Unusual number of XHR errors for account") fired **4× in 21:28-21:30 UTC**; currently OK (resolved)
  - Account `sdsautomation` dominates the captured sample (15/15 in account-scoped query, 15/30 in unscoped)
  - Mix of third-party + Method endpoints: `k.clarity.ms` ×4, `y.clarity.ms` ×3, `h.clarity.ms` ×1, `api.method.me` ×3, `sdsautomation.methodportal.com` ×8
  - All failures share the same shape: `error.origin: network`, `http.status_code: 0`, `error.stack: "Failed to load"`
  - All sdsautomation events from a **single browser session** (Chrome 142, Microsoft Corp ASN, San Jose IP `72.153.153.39`)

Trace IDs: (no server traces — `status_code:0` = request never reached the server)
Likely cause: **Client-side network blip for one user.** The mix of clarity.ms + method.me failures all returning status 0 is the signature of network-layer (DNS/proxy/extension/route-flap) issues, not server-side. Monitor cleared on its own.
Suggested next action: **monitor** for recurrence. If we see ≥3 similar single-account, mostly-clarity, all-zero-status bursts in the next week, promote to a false-alarm KB entry; until then leave alone — don't want to silence real per-account outages that happen to include a Clarity component.
